name: Bitten
source:
You thought you were passing through an ordinary small town, but an encounter with two sexy, mysterious strangers will change your life forever.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Bitten]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你本以为自己只是途经一座平平无奇的小镇，然而与两名性感神秘的陌生人的邂逅，却彻底改写了你的一生。
